name: House Of God
overview: The House of God is portrayed in Scripture as a sacred and holy place where believers are invited to come with reverence and a heart ready to listen, as emphasized in Ecclesiastes 5:1. It is a place of prayer and joyful worship, where God's presence strengthens and upholds His people (Isaiah 41:10; Psalms 122:1). The holiness of God's house is underscored by the call to purity and reverence, with its courts described as most holy and a place for praising the Lord (Ezekiel 43:12; Isaiah 62:9). The psalmist expresses a deep longing to be near God's dwelling, valuing even the lowliest position there over the company of the wicked (Psalms 84:10).
